quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) press release: Resonac to Make Additional Investment of Approximately (07-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hard disk media: Resonac decided on an additional investment of approximately US$100 million at Resonac HD Singapore Pte. Ltd., the Group's core hard disk media production site, following its May 2026 capacity-expansion announcement. Using certain idle equipment, and including the May 2026 expansion, annual production capacity will increase by 44% from the current level of approximately 160 million disks to approximately 230 million disks per year; production lines are scheduled to be launched in phases from 2029 onward in accordance with market conditions and customer demand. Resonac also reached an agreement with its HDD manufacturer customers on a price revision equivalent to the investment amount, reflecting growing demand from data center applications, aiming for both enhanced supply capacity and improved profitability. Resonac describes itself as the world's only merchant supplier of hard disk media and expects data center storage demand to keep growing over the medium to long term on generative AI and cloud services, with nearline HDDs continuing to play a central role.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately US$100 million; capacity from approximately 160 million to approximately 230 million disks per year (+44%); lines from 2029 onward
